offering_description.value: Provides specialty contracting services that build, maintain and upgrade telecommunications networks. Serves telecommunications carriers, cable operators and utilities across the United States, delivering work through its own crews on customer-directed projects.

primary_services.value: fiber and copper network installation; wireless network infrastructure construction; underground utility construction; network maintenance and repair; engineering and locating services

customer_segment.value: B2B: telecommunications carriers, cable operators, utilities and other infrastructure owners

end_markets.value: telecommunications; cable and broadband; utilities; wireless infrastructure

revenue_model.value: project or contract: contracted construction and maintenance work billed to customers under master service agreements; service fees: ongoing network maintenance, locating and repair services

value_chain_position.value: service provider: performs construction and maintenance labor on networks, sold to carriers, cable operators and utilities

geography_served.value: US national: operations across many states throughout the United States

specialization.value: related lines: outside plant, wireless and utility infrastructure services that share telecom customers and field crews

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: contracts negotiated directly with telecom carriers and utilities

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: worker safety and environmental rules, state contractor licensing and utility locating requirements, overseen by OSHA and state agencies
